title: Currency conversion rates and timing
summary: Explains Rho-Bank foreign currency conversions: rate = interbank rate + 0.5% markup. Card transactions use the network rate at authorization or settlement (final posting may change), while wallet exchanges confirm the rate at execution; applied rate and markup are shown in transaction details after completion.
